name: wraplines
signature: wraplines(unsigned char *data, Py_ssize_t size, size_t width)
note: review: The model (BinasciiC.lean:91) is a forward take/drop specification, not the backward memmove loop with line_len = size - newlines*width. WraplinesLaw is existential and allows an empty last line, so a wraplines that adds a trailing newline when len is a multiple of width passes (ls = [s1, s2, []]). That case is exactly what C's (size-1)/width newline count decides: b2a_base64(b'abcabc', wrapcol=4, newline=False) gives b'YWJjnYWJj' with no trailing newline.
